summary: Full e2e test of SAPA Sewa Gedung app. Backend: 34 pytest cases across settings, auth/JWT, bookings CRUD + status transitions, image upload/serve (Emergent objstore), admin account CRUD -> 33 passed, 1 xfail (no brute-force lockout). Frontend: verified landing (4 room cards), room detail modal with Shadcn date pickers, add-ons + qty pricing, add-to-cart toast + badge, cart slide-over checkout with QRIS (placeholder shown) -> booking created with Pending status and cart cleared; admin login via 'S' logo (invalid creds show correct error), /admin dashboard metrics + popular rooms + status breakdown + bookings table, status dropdown change persists after reload, CSV export downloads (bookings-sapa-2026-08-28.csv), Settings/CMS hero edit saved and reflected on public landing, Accounts tab lists owner admin with create form. All core flows work.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / rate limiting or account lockout: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no throttle (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails)

allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS="*" is an invalid combination per spec (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Harmless today because auth uses Bearer header, but should use explicit origins.

Accepts an arbitrary dict ({data: {...}}) with no Pydantic schema for rooms/addons/prices — an admin typo or malicious payload can write arbitrary keys/shape into the settings doc and break the public page.
No password strength/min-length validation (1-char password accepted); no username format validation.
No server-side validation that checkout > checkin, days>0, or that totals/prices match current settings — client-supplied totals are trusted (price tampering possible).

ui_bugs.issue: Reset uses native window.confirm() instead of Shadcn AlertDialog (inconsistent with rest of app, breaks automated flows). API reset itself works.

Check-out Calendar has no defaultMonth/month bound to the selected check-in, so when check-in is in a future month the popover opens on the current month with every day disabled — user must manually click the next-month arrow and may think it is broken.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on room detail and login modals (a11y).

issues: Sonner toasts render top-right directly over the Logout button; while a toast is visible Logout is visually obscured (click still lands after toast dismisses). Consider bottom-right toasts in admin.
Modal content is taller than viewport at 1920x1080; the primary 'Tambah ke Keranjang' CTA is below the fold and requires scrolling inside the modal — consider a sticky footer CTA.

action_items: Add defaultMonth={checkin} (and month state) to the check-out Calendar in RoomDetailModal so the popover opens on a month with selectable dates
Replace window.confirm in AdminSettings reset with Shadcn AlertDialog
Add login rate limiting / lockout after 5 failed attempts (playbook requirement)
Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origin(s) instead of '*' when allow_credentials=True
Server-side validate booking payload (checkout > checkin) and recompute totals from settings instead of trusting client
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/bookings trusts client-provided base_price/room_total/addons_total/total — recompute server-side from settings to prevent price tampering.
PUT /api/settings takes an unvalidated dict and $set's it directly; add a Pydantic Settings model (rooms/addons/hero) to avoid corrupting the single app_settings document.
GET /api/files/{path} passes the user-supplied path straight to object storage; it is only checked against db.files for content-type. Consider requiring the DB record to exist before fetching.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown; migrate to lifespan handlers.
Storage calls (requests.put/get) are synchronous inside async endpoints and block the event loop during uploads/downloads — wrap in run_in_threadpool.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional (3 minor UI/UX defects)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q). Auth is Bearer-token/localStorage by design (no httpOnly cookie), so playbook cookie checks are N/A; brute-force lockout is genuinely missing (test_brute_force_lockout xfails - it will start passing once implemented). For Playwright date pickers use button[name="day"]:not([disabled]) and remember the checkout calendar may need next-month navigation. AdminSettings reset triggers native window.confirm - register an async dialog handler (await d.accept()) or it hangs. Existing booking 'Budi' status was changed to Confirmed during dashboard testing.
rca_of_the_issue: Checkout date picker 'no selectable days' RCA: Calendar in RoomDetailModal.jsx (line ~168) has disabled={(d) => !checkin || d <= checkin} but no defaultMonth, so react-day-picker shows today's month; if check-in falls in a later month all visible days are disabled. UI settings reset appearing to fail RCA: window.confirm at AdminSettings.jsx:110 was auto-dismissed by Playwright; the /api/settings/reset endpoint itself works (verified via pytest).
